g7.pivot_rule: drawn round the roof base point o; pivot = o + (0, round(15.52 m x 9.8) + 19 px sort shift); every state but built is cropped to its opaque rect and carries its own pivot

g7_detail_level.budget_basis: packed atlas bytes (cells cropped to opaque rect, rows 2/6/7 mirrored when allowed)
g7_detail_level.mask: soldiers: armband on both upper arms + leader helmet band; vehicles/air: roof ID panel + side chevrons + hull stripe; Machine: plating trim
g7_detail_level.outline: selective: lit side = material deep tone, shadow side = pix.OUTLINE
g7_detail_level.palette: 5-tone hue-shifted ramp per material [deep, shade, mid, lit, glint]; light upper-left; muted military palettes
g7_detail_level.scale: ONE real-world scale: 4 m per 64x32 tile, 9.8 px per metre of height (1.8 m soldier = 18 px)
g7_detail_level.shading: per-pixel lit volumes; hull bevels, panel seams, rivets, grime band, chipped-paint wear
